svg.title: Uno R3 HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor Connections

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: HC-SR04 logical pins: VCC, TRIG, ECHO, GND

g.desc: HC-SR04 logical pins: VCC, TRIG, ECHO, GND

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: The common HC-SR04 ECHO signal is 5 V and is suitable for this 5 V Uno input. Do not assume it is safe for a 3.3 V MCU.

g.desc: The common HC-SR04 ECHO signal is 5 V and is suitable for this 5 V Uno input. Do not assume it is safe for a 3.3 V MCU.

g.text: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks cover the drawing only; the module and distance readings are untested.

g.desc: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks cover the drawing only; the module and distance readings are untested.

g.text: J1 is a logical four-wire connector, not a board footprint. Confirm the labels on the specific HC-SR04 module before connecting it.

g.desc: J1 is a logical four-wire connector, not a board footprint. Confirm the labels on the specific HC-SR04 module before connecting it.

g.text: Common 5 V module mapping: VCC to Uno 5 V; TRIG to D7; ECHO to D8; GND to common ground.

g.desc: Common 5 V module mapping: VCC to Uno 5 V; TRIG to D7; ECHO to D8; GND to common ground.
